goal: Add the recipes from recipes.jpg in Simple Gallery Pro to the Broccoli recipe app.

row_objects.title: Kale and Quinoa Salad
row_objects.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
row_objects.directions: Toss chopped kale, cooked quinoa, dried cranberries, sliced almonds, and feta cheese with a lemon vinaigrette. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

row_objects.title: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Chicken
row_objects.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
row_objects.directions: Stuff chicken breasts with a mixture of spinach, feta, garlic, and herbs. Bake until chicken is cooked through. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

row_objects.title: Turkey and Cheese Panini
row_objects.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
row_objects.directions: Layer turkey and cheese on bread, grill in a panini press until golden. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

noise_row_objects.title: Cauliflower Fried "Rice"
noise_row_objects.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
noise_row_objects.directions: Pulse cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice. Sauté with vegetables, soy sauce, and add scrambled eggs. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

noise_row_objects.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
noise_row_objects.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
noise_row_objects.directions: Mix cooked quinoa, black beans, corn, tomato sauce, and spices. Stuff into bell peppers and bake until tender. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

noise_row_objects.title: Cauliflower Fried "Rice"
noise_row_objects.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
noise_row_objects.directions: Pulse cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice. Sauté with vegetables, soy sauce, and add scrambled eggs. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

noise_row_objects.title: Salmon with Dill Sauce
noise_row_objects.description: An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.
noise_row_objects.directions: Bake salmon fillets and serve with a sauce made from Greek yogurt, dill, lemon juice, and garlic. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

noise_row_objects.title: Chickpea Vegetable Soup
noise_row_objects.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
noise_row_objects.directions: Sauté onions, carrots, and celery, add broth, canned tomatoes, and chickpeas. Simmer with spinach and seasonings. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.

noise_row_objects.title: BBQ Chicken Quesadillas
noise_row_objects.description: A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.
noise_row_objects.directions: Mix shredded cooked chicken with BBQ sauce. Place on tortillas with cheese, fold and cook until crispy. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

noise_row_objects.title: Avocado Toast with Egg
noise_row_objects.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
noise_row_objects.directions: Toast bread, top with mashed avocado, a fried egg, salt, pepper, and chili flakes. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.

noise_row_objects.title: Beef Stir Fry
noise_row_objects.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
noise_row_objects.directions: Stir-fry beef slices with broccoli, bell peppers, and onions in soy sauce and garlic. Serve over rice or noodles. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

noise_row_objects.title: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
noise_row_objects.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
noise_row_objects.directions: Sauté onions, garlic, carrots, and spices. Add canned chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth. Simmer until flavors meld. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.

noise_row_objects.title: Vegetable Stir Fry with Tofu
noise_row_objects.description: A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.
noise_row_objects.directions: Stir-fry tofu cubes until golden, add assorted vegetables and a stir-fry sauce. Serve over rice or noodles. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.
